captions.detailed: A miniature hot-shoe camera flash unit made of matte black plastic. It features a tall rectangular body with a small red test button, a horizontal gray status light, and a mounting foot at the bottom. The boxy flash head has a rectangular light-emitting window on the front and is connected to the body via a short cylindrical neck that swivels horizontally, while the head itself tilts vertically on a rear-mounted joint mechanism.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an articulated hot-shoe camera flash. The model should consist of three main parts: a vertical rectangular body with a mounting foot and simple buttons on the front, a cylindrical swiveling neck, and a boxy flash head with a front-facing rectangular reflector that can tilt vertically.
captions.factory: Construct the model using three articulated parts. First, create the 'body' link using a vertical Box, adding smaller colored Box primitives for the mounting foot, red test button, and status indicator. Second, define the 'neck' link using a Cylinder primitive. Connect the body and neck with a revolute joint rotating around the Z-axis. Third, construct the 'head' link using a horizontal Box for the housing, and inset rectangular boxes for the flash window and reflector panel. Attach the head to the neck using a horizontal revolute joint aligned with the Y-axis.
